contentText:
Netón Vega and El de Las R’s shake up the top 10 of the Hot Latin Songs chart, but will either be able to take No. 1 from Bad Bunny?

Narrator: Here’s the Billboard Hot Latin Songs Top 10 for the week dated July 18! Netón Vega notches his ninth top 10. “Todo Lo Fue” bounces back to No. 9. “Daño” steps up to eight. “De Lejitos” reaches a new high at No. 7. “Koko” climbs to six. El de Las R’s lands his first top 10 at No. 5. “Voy a Llevarte Pa PR” charges back at four. “Ayúdame” powers up to No. 3. “Nuevayol” cruises into two. And “DTMF” holds firm at No. 1 for a 68th week!
